1 OFFICE ASSISTANT (M/F/D) 20-40 hours per week  Based in Leoben

Your Role
HOT Engineering GmbH is looking for a reliable, organised and service-oriented Office Assistant to support the smooth day-to-day operation of our Leoben office.

In this role, you will be an important point of contact for colleagues, visitors, clients and external service providers and will support our team with a broad range of administrative and organisational tasks.

We are looking for someone who enjoys keeping things organised, takes responsibility for day-to-day office matters and contributes to a professional and welcoming working environment.

Your Responsibilities
 * Managing general office administration and ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation of the Leoben office
 * Handling incoming calls, emails, mail and deliveries, as well as welcoming visitors, clients and business partners
 * Coordinating meeting rooms, appointments, business trips and internal events
 * Managing office supplies and coordinating with external service providers, suppliers and building management
 * Preparing, formatting and maintaining documents, spreadsheets, presentations, files and internal records
 * Supporting basic finance-related administration, including invoice processing, travel expenses and related documentation
 * Assisting with onboarding, general HR administration and organisational requests from colleagues
 * Providing general administrative and organisational support to different departments as required 

Your Profile
We are looking for a well-organised and dependable person who enjoys working with people and has a hands-on approach to office administration.

You should bring: 
 * Very good German and English skills, both written and spoken
 * Strong organisational and administrative skills
 * A structured, accurate and reliable way of working
 * Good communication skills and a friendly, professional manner
 * Confidence in dealing with colleagues, clients, suppliers and other external contacts
 * Good knowledge of Microsoft Teams & Office, particularly Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint
 * The ability to manage several tasks and priorities at the same time
 * A proactive and practical mindset
 * A high level of discretion and reliability
 * Previous experience in office administration, reception, team assistance or a similar role is an advantage
 * Experience in an international company or technical environment is a plus, but not required. 

What We Offer
 * A varied administrative role in an international company
 * A friendly and professional working environment
 * Close cooperation with colleagues across different departments
 * An international environment with clients and projects across Europe, the Middle East, Africa and beyond
 * A broad range of responsibilities and the opportunity to work independently
 * Flexible working hours between 20 and 40 hours per week
 * A workplace at our Leoben office
 * Short decision-making processes and a hands-on working culture
 * A long-term position with the opportunity to grow into additional responsibilities over time

Interested?

If you are organised, reliable, enjoy working with people and like making sure that everything in an office runs smoothly, we would be pleased to hear from you.

Please send us your CV together with a short introduction outlining your background, motivation and preferred number of weekly working hours.

For legal reasons, we would like to point out that the minimum gross monthly salary for this position according to the applicable Austrian collective agreement is EUR 2.303,13 (full-time basis). The actual remuneration will reflect qualifications and professional experience, with overpayment depending on the individual profile.

Please send your application documents to:

application@hoteng.com
Attn.: Ms Laura Kratzer

 * Working knowledge of EU aviation safety regulations, AOC operations specifications and operations manual requirements.
 * A sound grasp of statistical principles and confidence working with data and trends.

jobs.occupation: Senior DevOps Engineer - AWS Cloud Migrations (f/m/d) - 4-Days-Week
jobs.description:
Auvaria is an award-winning consulting and engineering company located in Vienna with offices in Hamburg, and Belgrade. Our mission is to support customers with passion and certified expert knowledge throughout their entire cloud journey, driving their digital transformation forward. As a successful partner to many market leaders such as AWS, we live and breathe digital cloud transformation - dedicated to accelerating c... 1 Senior DevOps Engineer - AWS Cloud Migrations (f/m/d) - 4-Days-Week It's time to change. We change!
Welcome to Auvaria, where passion, team spirit, responsibility and courage form the basis of our culture. We are an AWS consulting and engineering partner helping clients modernize and migrate their workloads to the cloud: pragmatically, securely and at scale.

To do so, we are looking for a motivated and solution-oriented team player (f/m/d) with a feeling for individual client requirements and a strong hands-on mentality. As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will play an important role in the implementation of complex cloud projects and take responsibility for the technical architecture and implementation of various cloud solutions for our customers with a primary focus on migration topics. 

AWS Cloud Migrations & Delivery

 * Lead and implement AWS cloud migration projects
 * Design and build secure landing zones
 * Migrate applications, infrastructure and databases to AWS
 * Support cutovers and production go-lives with a strong focus on stability and security

DevOps & Platform Engineering

 * Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines
 * Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
 * Automate cloud environments and deployments
 * Ensure observability using monitoring, logging and alerting tools

Containers & Cloud-Native Workloads

 * Migrate and operate containerized workloads using Kubernetes (EKS) or ECS/Fargate
 * Improve reliability, scalability and performance of workloads

Customer Collaboration

 * Act as a trusted technical counterpart for customer teams
 * Support migration scoping and technical estimations
 * Clearly communicate trade-offs and architectural decisions

This way, you can realise your full potential and strengthen the entire team at the same time!

Your profile:
Required

 * 4+ years experience in DevOps, Platform or Cloud Engineering
 * Strong hands-on experience with AWS
 * Infrastructure as Code with Terraform
 * CI/CD pipeline design and operation
 * Container platforms: Kubernetes OR ECS
 * Fluent in English and German

Nice to have

 * AWS certifications 
 * Database migration experience 
 * SRE practices (monitoring, alerting, reliability concepts)
